messages:
Lena (social): Quick heads-up — planning a multi-stage social push tied to next week's webinar + the benchmark narrative. Need assets, CTAs, and an engagement follow-up plan.

Maria (marketing): Love it. Objective? signups vs. leads vs. impressions? Also which audiences (devs, platform, infra)?

Ajay (growth): Primary goal = qualified demo requests (SDR follow). Secondary = signups. Audience: product/platform engineers at mid-market and enterprise.

Tim (pm): Dates? Webinar is Wed May 6 11am PT. We should do a pre-launch cadence (teaser -> benchmark stat -> registration -> 24h reminder -> hour reminder).

Jenna (design): Assets I can prepare: 1) 30s clip of speaker highlight (16:9), 2) three quote cards (1200x628 & 1080x1080), 3) benchmark chart PNG (transparent bg), 4) registration thumbnail. Need copy ASAP.

Lena (social): Perfect. Quick ask: can design export a 15s vertical cut for X/TikTok use? Also need a 280-char X headline + 2 LinkedIn post lengths (short/long).

Jenna (design): Yep can do vertical 15s crop. ETA for first drafts: EOD Tue. Will include source Figma links.

Ajay (growth): Benchmark narrative: highlight 30% inferencing cost reduction vs baseline + 2x throughput at p95. Want one clear stat for the hero card, then 2 supporting bullets for carousel. Keep language non-technical for LinkedIn primary audience.

Maria (marketing): CTA options: (A) Register for webinar (primary) -> /register?utm=webinar_may6 (B) Download benchmark + sign up -> /download?utm=benchmark_share (C) Demo request -> /demo?utm=social_demo. We should A/B headline/CTA across channels.

Rosa (sdr): Routing note — please tag leads from LinkedIn X form as "webinar_may6" in our CRM and assign to SDR queue "inbound-webinar". For demo CTA, route to enterprise SDRs.

Lena (social): Thanks Rosa. We'll add UTM+hidden fields to forms. Can someone confirm if Marketing Ops can create the form with those hidden fields? @Maria

Maria (marketing): I can create the LinkedIn lead gen form template today and share to #marketing-ops for hidden fields + CRM mapping.

Lena (social): Draft posting schedule (suggested):
```
- Mon May 4 10:00 PT: Teaser X (15s clip) + LinkedIn short (CTA A)
- Tue May 5 11:30 PT: Benchmark stat card (hero) across LinkedIn + X (CTA B)
- Wed May 6 08:00 PT: Registration reminder X thread + LinkedIn long post (CTA A)
- Wed May 6 10:00 PT: 1 hour reminder X (short) + LinkedIn story-style post
- Thu May 7 09:00 PT: Post-webinar benchmark recap + download link (CTA B)
```

Lena (social): Posting times chosen for US reach. If we want EU push, add Tue May 5 16:00 CET boost. Thoughts?

Ajay (growth): Add EU boost for the stat card. Also add UTM param for region (utm_region=eu/us). We'll track conversions separately.

Jenna (design): Quick brand note: use warm gradient background for quote cards (see figma file: https://figma.com/s/redwood/benchmark-cards). I'll drop exact color hexes in the asset pack.

Maria (marketing): Copy variants — short (X) and long (LinkedIn). Two CTA permutations for A/B. Drafts below, please react with :thumbsup: on preferred phrasing or suggest edits.

Lena (social): Post copy drafts:
1) X short (teaser): "Next Wed we’re sharing how we cut inferencing unit cost by 30% while improving p95. Join the webinar — register: https://redwood.ai/register?utm=webinar_may6 #inference #LLM"

2) LinkedIn short (stat lead): "Benchmark: 30% lower per-token inferencing cost, 2x p95 throughput. Hear our approach and real-world tradeoffs at our webinar on May 6. Register: https://redwood.ai/register?utm=webinar_may6"

3) LinkedIn long (narrative): "Serving LLMs reliably at scale means balancing latency, cost, and quality. In our upcoming webinar we’ll walk through an apples-to-apples benchmark showing a 30% cost reduction and 2x throughput improvement — plus the rollout and quality checks that made it possible. Reserve your seat: https://redwood.ai/register?utm=webinar_may6"

Maria (marketing): Edits: swap "per-token inferencing cost" -> "inference unit cost" for simpler language. Also add speaker names to LinkedIn long. @Tim can you paste speaker line?

Tim (pm): Speakers: Priya Rao (Prod), Daniel Kim (Infra). I'll drop a one-liner for each in the doc.

Rosa (sdr): For engagement follow-ups after webinar: 1) Attended & high interest => immediate SDR outreach (same day) 2) Registered but no-show => nurture email + CTA for on-demand + 3-day touch 3) Downloaders of benchmark => qualify via lead score then SDR. We'll need tagging rules documented.

Lena (social): Engagement follow-up cadence noted. I'll prepare a comment card for each post: quick reply script for community managers + 2x saved responses for common questions (pricing, private deploy, dedicated).

Maria (marketing): Approvals needed: 1) Copy 2) Assets 3) Landing/form hidden fields. I'll collate and send a review thread. Timeline: want approvals by Tue EOD so we can schedule Wed posts.

Jenna (design): Uploading first draft to Figma now. Link will be posted here in ~90m.

Lena (social): Small ask — include alt text for images (accessibility) in the asset pack.

Jenna (design): Will do alt text and plain-text transcript for the 30s clip.

Maria (marketing): I'll set up the A/B CTA split in the scheduling tool. @Lena can you confirm which copy goes to which variant?

Lena (social): Variant A = registration-first copy. Variant B = benchmark-download-first. I'll mark in the scheduling doc.

SocialBot: Scheduled slot suggestions generated: 3 optimal windows for X: 10:00 PT, 11:30 PT, 16:00 CET. Scheduling draft saved as "webinar_may6_social_draft".

Ajay (growth): One more thing — let's create a short UTM mapping sheet to ensure analytics aligns with CRM routing. I'll draft that and share.

Maria (marketing): Great. Plan: Jenna drops assets -> Lena builds scheduling draft -> Maria builds forms and review thread -> Rosa confirms routing -> Ajay shares UTM mapping. Target: Tue EOD sign-off.

Lena (social): All right — I'll assemble the scheduling spreadsheet and tag everyone when the draft is ready. Thanks all :raised_hands:

Maria (marketing): Thanks team — will kick off form/template now.

SocialBot: Reminder scheduled: "Review copy + assets" on Tue 17:00 PT to #marketing.
